class: A frame disappears while submission-guard activation iterates frames
symptom: After authorized ADP emailed-code reauthentication, the runtime raised Frame.evaluate: Frame was detached from submission guard activation instead of continuing the application.
site: Church Mutual supervised ADP reauthentication on 25 October 2026; owning helper traceback through PageAgent._run_locked, protect_submission and SubmissionGuardV0.activate
root_cause: The page.frames list can become stale during navigation. activate propagates a Playwright exception from a frame that has already detached, even though that frame no longer exists to receive actions.
why_tests_missed: Containment tests cover navigation callbacks, reinjection and handoff parking but not detachment during the synchronous all-frames activation loop.
fix: Ignore an activation error only when the affected frame is confirmed detached, and continue protecting remaining frames. Errors on live frames still propagate; existing init scripts, frame callbacks and submission policy remain authoritative.
prevention: Exercise lifecycle races at enforcement boundaries with paired tests: disappearance may be recoverable, while the same failure on a live target must remain fail-closed.
